name: Rabid Helix
source:
In this game, you are the medic of a corporate security team in some sci-fi setting sent to investigate a long-abandoned research installation owned by the company's predecessor. Similar to the lieutenant of the Colonial Marines in Aliens, you sit behind a bank of monitors and observe your teammates' status as they investigate the interior of this compound. And like Aliens, something nasty is waiting for them inside.

[From [url=http://www.densetsu.com/display.php?id=165&style=alphabetical]animedensetsu[/url]]
translation:
在这款科幻背景游戏中，你将扮演企业安保团队的医务兵，被派去调查公司前身拥有的一座废弃研究设施。和《异形》中的殖民陆战队中尉相似，你坐在一排监视器后，观察队友调查设施内部的状态。而就像《异形》一样，里面正等待着某种可怕之物。

[来源：[url=http://www.densetsu.com/display.php?id=165&style=alphabetical]animedensetsu[/url]]
